greetings.text: You again. Drink or leave, {player}, I've tables to clear.
Come in out of that rain before you catch your death!
Evening, love. Busy night. What'll it be?

greetings: Welcome in! Mind the floor, it's been mopped. Mostly.

topics.caption: The house ale

question.polite: What would you recommend to drink?

answers.text: It's wet and it's cheap. What more do you want?

answers: Brewed out back. Tastes of barley and regret, but it's the cheapest in {town}.
Two coppers a mug. Three if you want it cold.
Here you go, love. Mind the foam.
Steady now. That's your last one from me tonight.
Suit yourself. The rats drink for free anyway.

topics.caption: Any rumours?

question.polite: Have you heard any interesting rumours?

answers: Rumours? I hear plenty. A sailor's gone missing from the docks, for one. Jory. Ask me about him if you care.

topics.caption: The missing sailor

answers.text: Why should I tell you? ...Fine. Last seen heading for the old warehouse.

answers: Jory drank here every night, then nothing. Last seen near the old warehouse, poor soul. If you go looking, be careful.
Would you? Bless you, {player}. Try the old warehouse first.

replies.text: What aren't you telling me? (10 gold)
answers: Jory owed money to a man called Skeffing. Nasty sort. If Jory's anywhere, Skeffing knows.

topics.caption: A favour
topics.question: Is there anything I can do about Jory?
answers: If you find him, tell him his tab's forgiven. I'd just like to know he's alive. Thank you, {player}.

topics.caption: Late hours
answers: The night crowd's rougher. Keep your purse close and your back to the wall.

topics.caption: Rainy days
answers: Rain's good for business. Nobody wants to drink in a puddle.

topics.caption: Winter
answers: Cold enough to freeze the ale in the barrels. Sit by the fire, {player}.

topics.caption: Your coin purse
answers: That's a heavy purse you're carrying. I'd keep it out of sight in here.

answers.text: A guild sword! Good. I'm glad of someone who can stop a brawl.
A mage? Don't set anything on fire. The last one singed my eyebrows.
